contea di ritrovamento: Darlington (Inghilterra e Galles)

A military lead sealing of the ​ala Hispanorum Vettonum dating to the late second or third century AD. The sealing is rectangular in shape and in section. The obverse is struck with the legend 'AVET' ​'a(la) Vet(tonum)' ​and the reverse with the legend 'SLD' retrograde ' S(...) L(...) d(ecurio).
